<div class="card-body">
'''TIE Scout''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイ・スカウト（偵察機）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロット１名と乗客２名、あるいは乗客２名を乗せることができる。能力値１の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-305o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">限定生産の偵察用軽宇宙機。装甲と火力は最小限のものしか持たない。長距離センサーと通信装備を持つ。反乱軍の行動を偵察する任務にあたる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' TIE Scout (Reconnaissance Craft).

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot and two passengers, or two passengers. A permanent pilot with ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' A light reconnaissance spacecraft produced in limited numbers. It has minimal armor and firepower but carries long-range sensors and communications equipment. Its mission is to scout Rebel activity.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' May carry one pilot and two passengers, or two passengers; the English may add 1 pilot and 1 passenger, or 2 passengers.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[TIE Scout]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
